formattedAddress: 106, Taiwan, Taipei City, Da’an District, Quan'an Village, Leli Rd, 40號1樓

text.text:
Every detail is beautifully coordinated and executed. From the food and drinks, to the cutlery, crockery and bathroom tiling! We came for brunch and coffee, and the ingredients were stunningly fresh and brilliantly cooked. The portions aren’t huge but we took our time and it certainly did the job. The Panna Cotta went stunningly with our coffees, and ended the meal with such class and grins.
We will certainly return soon, but next time I will order two smaller dishes instead of the “large” steak and salmon platter, which was the exact same size as my ladies’ cheaper dish.
Well done Bloom, see you soon x

text.text:
The cafe was not very busy when we visited (about 2pm), but our dessert pudding, which was already premade in the fridge and just needed toppings sprinkled on top, took almost 30 minutes to arrive after we finished eating our pasta/main course! We finished eating for 10 minutes, but the staff didn't notice we were done, and had to personally go up and request our dessert, after which it took almost 20 minutes to arrive (and we had to get up and ask the waiter where our dessert was). The whole time while we were waiting, I could see the staff putting away clean dishes in the mirror. It felt like they were ignoring us.

Our actual pasta was mediocre. The noodles just tasted like cheap store-bought pasta, the sauce was oversalted and didn't stick to the noodles, and the portion size was extremely small.

Not just the pasta size was extremely small, but everything was extremely small. We paid over $300 for a pasta whose plate was bigger than the actual serving size (which took less than 10 minutes to eat).

Furthermore, the hot chocolate lacked a deep chocolate flavor, was very thin, and the only special thing about it was some whipped cream on top with some cocoa. Otherwise it tasted very average- roughly the same as the instant hot chocolate you can buy in the store.

Not to mention, there was a 10% non-optional service fee. Based on the long wait time, lack of care in the service, extremely small portions and extremely high price, I am shocked at why there are so many high reviews.

text.text: its a nice cozy place to hangout and spend time with friends or family. the foods also good, we ordered bacon garlic pasta, caramel pudding, and cheesecake. the pasta have plenty of bacon slices, the garlic and dried chili gave fragrant smell, and the pasta itself cooked just perfect. the caramel pudding is sweet, topped with cream and caramel bits, which match well with the pudding texture, soft and silky. the cheesecake also a yum, its dense but not firm, so soft, and the grated lime on top totally complete the dish. the service is top notch, all the staff is warm and responsive, our food came out quickly and perfect.
